requires.label: Patient must reside in Gunnison, Hinsdale, or Saguache County
requires.quote: GVH and FMC provides financial assistance to Gunnison, Hinsdale, and Saguache County residents

requires.label: Patient must be uninsured or underinsured
requires.quote: committed proving emergency and medically necessary care to patients who are uninsured, or who have a limited insurance (underinsured)

rules.label: Free care for income at or below 400% FPL
rules.quote: You may be eligible for financial assistance for emergency or medically necessary healthcare services, if your family income is below 400 percent of the federal poverty guidelines

payment_plan.quote: Any patient eligible for discounting will be required to pay their copay or percentage due upon determination of their eligibility, or they must sign an approved payment plan contract

notes: Policy states patients qualifying for assistance will not be charged more than amounts generally billed to insured patients (AGB cap).
Service area limited to Gunnison, Hinsdale, and Saguache Counties; 'in_service_area' variable used as proxy for county residency.
Collections: Notification Period of 120 days with at least three billing statements, seriously past due notice, and final notice before ECA.
ECA may begin only after final notice plus 30 days; modeled as 150 days from first_statement (120-day notification period + 30-day wait).
Patients who qualify but fail to pay discounted balance are considered uncollectible bad debts and referred to outside agencies.
Application methods listed (mail, in-person, email, phone) but no application deadline stated.
Policy available in English and Spanish.
Exclusions for cosmetic, transplant, or research services not mentioned in this summary.

rules.label: Financial Assistance Program for income at or below 400% FPL
rules.quote: You may be eligible for financial assistance for emergency or medically necessary healthcare services, if your family income is below 400 percent of the federal poverty guidelines as published annually.

notes: The policy states that patients eligible for discounting will be required to pay their copay or percentage due upon determination of eligibility, or sign an approved payment plan contract, but does not specify exact payment plan terms.

The policy indicates that during the Notification Period (120 Days), the hospital provides at least three billing statements, a seriously past due notice, and a final notice, and may initiate ECA only after the final notice and at least 30 days have elapsed, but these are collections procedures, not requirements for receiving assistance.

The policy states that a patient qualifying for financial assistance will not be charged more than amounts generally billed (AGB) for the same services to insured patients, but AGB is not a fixed discount percent and varies by service, so discount_pct is null.

The policy mentions that financial assistance may also be available in other limited circumstances depending on the size of the medical bills and other criteria, but no specific thresholds or rules are provided, so no additional rules are included.
